answer: One funding thread feeds one grove, where each identity solves a sequential VDF puzzle whose delay starts at 1 hour and squares with its number on the thread: first 1 hour, tenth 100, hundredth 10,000, each chained to the one before it. Each identity completes its voyage after three auditors verify its proof within 24 hours. A forged proof voids the grove and restarts the delay from zero. 100 clones burn 338,350 hours at $2 an hour plus $2,500 bonds, $679,200; 100 honest agents pay $200 plus $2,500, just $2,700. A fake fleet becomes one queue at a toll booth squaring its price each step.
